name: Robust Depth Loss
definition: A loss function designed to address geometry error degradation in extrapolation performance by being less sensitive to outliers than L2 loss, encouraging NeRF to terminate rays around pseudo depth while retaining freedom for inaccurate geometry.
summary: Robust Depth Loss is a geometry supervision function that mitigates noise in pseudo-depth maps by using a logarithmic regime for large errors, making it less sensitive to outliers than standard L2 loss.
